purpose: Evaluate whether grounded answers help a reader explain technical material in an interview, adapt to requested depth, and handle follow-up questions without unsupported claims.
provenance: Questions, ideal-answer criteria, likely follow-ups, and failure guards were authored from model knowledge. Candidate evidence anchors were matched to the table of contents and page ranges in the four production books. Five Designing Machine Learning Systems anchors reuse topics already judged in the existing retrieval and multi-turn gold sets. All other evidence mappings remain candidate anchors until a human checks the cited pages and promotes the dataset.
intended_use: Compare prompt-profile revisions on a frozen set of interview questions.
Separate answer-presentation failures from retrieval and grounding failures.
Check quick, interview, and deep response behavior.
Exercise concept, system-design, chapter-review, follow-up, and abstention behavior.
exclusions: This seed is not a final human-verified gold set.
The must-cover lists are semantic scoring criteria, not text that an answer must reproduce verbatim.
Candidate evidence anchors do not prove that every listed criterion is supported until page-level human review.
The set is intentionally balanced for diagnostic coverage and is not a statistical sample of all interview questions.

grounded_correctness.description: Technical claims agree with the judged source evidence and preserve important qualifications.
grounded_correctness.score_0: Core explanation is wrong, contradicted by the source, or mostly invented.
grounded_correctness.score_2: Main idea is usable but contains a meaningful error or loses important qualifications.
grounded_correctness.score_4: Core and supporting claims are accurate, appropriately qualified, and grounded.

interview_readiness.description: The answer can be spoken and defended in an interview, including reasoning and trade-offs rather than isolated facts.
interview_readiness.score_0: Does not answer the interview question or is unusably disorganized.
interview_readiness.score_2: Answers the question but gives limited reasoning, trade-offs, or defensible structure.
interview_readiness.score_4: Starts with a strong direct response and develops reasoning, trade-offs, and likely probes naturally.

coverage.description: The answer includes the case-specific must-cover concepts without padding.
coverage.score_2: Covers roughly half the important concepts or treats them superficially.
coverage.score_4: Covers all required concepts at the requested depth without irrelevant expansion.

depth_adherence.description: The response follows the effective quick, interview, or deep request, including explicit natural-language overrides.
depth_adherence.score_2: Roughly appropriate but noticeably too shallow, repetitive, or long.
depth_adherence.score_4: Matches the requested depth and prioritizes detail appropriately.

clarity_memorability.description: The explanation uses clear sequencing, meaningful comparisons, and memorable mental models supported by evidence.
clarity_memorability.score_0: Confusing, fragmented, or dominated by unexplained terminology.
clarity_memorability.score_2: Understandable but difficult to retain or explain aloud.
clarity_memorability.score_4: Clear, economical, and memorable without oversimplifying.

follow_up_quality.description: Likely interviewer follow-ups are high-value, non-redundant, and paired with useful concise answers when the requested depth permits.
follow_up_quality.score_0: Follow-ups are missing when required, irrelevant, or misleading.
follow_up_quality.score_2: Includes some useful probes but they are generic or weakly answered.
follow_up_quality.score_4: Selects the most diagnostic probes and answers them concisely from evidence.

citation_quality.description: Important claims carry exact, correctly placed source markers and no marker is attached to an unsupported claim.
citation_quality.score_0: Important claims are uncited or citations do not support them.
citation_quality.score_2: Most core claims are cited but placement or support is inconsistent.
citation_quality.score_4: Important claims are naturally and precisely cited with no citation inflation.
